items.headline: Ecuador extends scheduled power cuts for large industrial users to three days a week from 12 October
items.summary: Ecuador's Ministry of Environment and Energy will extend scheduled disconnections for high-voltage and medium-voltage industrial users to three days a week from 12 October, reported Radio Pichincha and Infobae (EFE). The government says the cuts are meant to protect reservoir levels at hydropower plants during the dry season. President Daniel Noboa said on 5 October that no household will face power cuts.
items.note: Technical reports cited by Radio Pichincha warn that residential rationing could follow if the dry season deepens. Industry groups warn that backup generation lasts less than 12 hours.
